_doc: Radioactive decay data for background gamma sources. BRs are per decay of the parent chain isotope (late chain secular equilibrium).

Bi214._doc: Bi-214 from U-238 late chain. Single gamma, no companions.

Tl208._doc: Tl-208 from Th-232 late chain. Main gamma always accompanied by at least one companion (from Tl-208 decay scheme). BR_from_chain = BR(Bi-212 -> Tl-208) x BR(Tl-208 -> 2.615 gamma).
